profile.description: Moondream-Next can describe images, detect objects or points in images, and detect a person's gaze in a photo. Pass in an image, a prompt to describe the task (for example, "detect all circles in this image", "caption this image") and specify the task to be performed with --task [task_name] (task_name ought to be one of `caption`, `bbox_detection`, `point_detection`, `gaze_detection`)
